title: PrivateTariff
description: One normalized private-tariff row as produced by the ai-engine tariff pipeline (ADR-006 section 3) for append-only insertion into app.private_tariffs by core-api. The natural key is (carrier_or_agent, modal, origin_locode, dest_locode, equipment_or_unit, charge_category, charge_code) per RFC-002 step 3. Every row is either a priced line or a tombstone (is_removed) that retires its natural key — see oneOf; batch assignment is applied by core-api and is not part of the wire shape.

carrier_or_agent.description: Carrier or agent issuing the rate, normalized (e.g. HAPAG, MAEU, or the origin-agent name as written by the tenant).

charge_category.description: Mirrors app.charge_category: the platform's coarse grouping. Only OCEAN_FREIGHT and the AIR_FREIGHT base are markup-eligible (RFC-001 v1.3); everything else passes through at cost.

charge_code.description: Free-text carrier-specific code (BAF, THC, FSC...). Deliberately not an enum: codes arrive from tariffs the platform does not control.

is_removed.description: Tombstone flag (RFC-002 step 3), required on the wire: true marks this natural key as removed in the batch and the row carries no price (see oneOf); false on a normal priced row. Written to the row by core-api.

currency.description: Required on priced rows, forbidden on tombstones (see oneOf).

net_amount.description: Net rate per unit (per container for FCL, per chargeable kg for AIR base freight, per unit otherwise). Decimal string, never a JSON number (ADR-008): a JSON number parses as float on first touch. Required on priced rows, forbidden on tombstones (see oneOf).

min_amount.description: Minimum charge applied instead of net_amount when the computed amount is lower (AIR: max(min_amount, chargeable_kg x net_amount)). Optional on priced rows, forbidden on tombstones.

valid_from.description: Required on priced rows, forbidden on tombstones (see oneOf).

valid_until.description: Inclusive. core-api enforces valid_from <= valid_until as a deterministic check. Required on priced rows, forbidden on tombstones.

search_description.description: Canonical service description embedded for retrieval ranking (codes filter first; vectors only rank valid rows). Required on priced rows, forbidden on tombstones.

embedding.description: Optional and nullable (Pedro, 2026-11-16): absent/null means ranking falls back to deterministic order. Forbidden on tombstones.

embedding_model.description: Pinned embedding model id (qwen/qwen3-embedding-8b in the MVP). Optional on priced rows, forbidden on tombstones.

source.description: Provenance of this row (decided by Pedro, 2026-11-16): where it came from, when, and with what content. content_hash + fetched_at are what the Devin repair loop and the audit screen use to state 'this line came from this file at this version'.

schema_version.description: Version of this source object's shape, so it can evolve without breaking previously persisted rows.

kind.description: Mirrors app.tariff_source_type ('CSV_UPLOAD','RESEND_INBOUND') plus FIRECRAWL_PUBLIC for portal-scraped tariffs. The FIRECRAWL_* value requires a new app.tariff_source_type enum value via a later migration — schema change pending Pedro's approval at that migration.

ref.description: Source locator: portal URL for FIRECRAWL_PUBLIC, file name for CSV_UPLOAD, resend_message_id for RESEND_INBOUND.

fetched_at.description: When the source content was retrieved.

content_hash.description: Hash of the fetched payload (e.g. sha256 hex); pins the row to an exact source version for audit and repair.

oneOf.title: PricedTariffRow
oneOf.description: A live rate: the value (net_amount) and its currency are REQUIRED, the value is a decimal string and never a JSON number (Pedro, 2026-11-16; ADR-008).

oneOf.title: TombstoneTariffRow
oneOf.description: A removal marker for the natural key (RFC-002 step 3): carries no price, so value fields are forbidden — a missing value can never slip through as 'optional'.
